title: Tunisian Baked Fish Tagine Recipe
description: A flavorful and aromatic baked fish tagine recipe, inspired by the traditional North African dish, with a blend of Tunisian spices and a squeeze of lemon.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the vibrant olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the Tunisian spice mix and stir for 1 minute.
Add the fish fillets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
While the fish is baking, heat the tagine broth in a separate saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in the lemon juice and chopped parsley and cilantro.
Serve the baked fish with the tagine broth sauce spooned over the top.
